summary: Full E2E test of the new Weekly Payouts feature (admin). Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass covering auth gating (401/403), weeks bounds (0/27 -> 422; default 8; explicit N), newest-first ordering, Monday-Sunday calendar, per-row invariants (prepaid+cash+discounts == order_value; owed == order_value - cash_in_hand), totals equal sum of rows, vendor_id filter, unknown vendor returns empty weeks, and cross-check vs /admin/vendors/{id}/finances. Frontend: admin login -> admin-tab-payouts shows week label '5 Oct – 11 Oct' with prev/next arrows (next disabled on current week, prev disabled after walking 7 weeks back), all four tiles render correct totals (₹9,390 / ₹0 / ₹80 / ₹9,470 matching API sum), payout-table has rows for Gourmet Kitchen, Down South Cafe, Chai Point Hostel 4 with correct owed values, clicking payout-stall-<id> navigates to Finances tab and renders stall-payouts-table with 8 stall-payout-week-<YYYY-MM-DD> rows. Regression: all admin tabs (overview, orders, finances, stalls, prices, coupons, payouts) render and each tab switch resets scrollY to 0.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/app/modules/admin/payouts.py build_payouts: SQL groups by date_trunc('week', ...) which in Postgres is ISO (Monday-based) -> matches week_start calculation. Correct.

AdminPayouts.tsx: SplitBar divides by (prepaid+cash+discounts) which equals order_value by invariant; safe. Totals row 'All stalls' uses vendor_id=uuid(int=0) sentinel - fine, but if ever rendered as a row via vendor_id key it could collide; currently only shown in <tfoot>, no issue.

Unknown vendor_id on /admin/payouts returns 200 with empty weeks instead of 404. Not required by spec (spec allows this) but inconsistent with /admin/vendors/{id}/finances which 404s on unknown vendor. Low priority.
